Verdict

Not a parity check: PR 6813 (HEAD 32a7bd049) moves the homepage breakpoints to Tailwind's (576→640, 992→1024, 1200→1280 container and xl layouts, 1400→1536 guide rails, 1521→1536 FinalCTA fade); 32a7bd049 puts the hero's Claude Code window over the dashboard from 1024 (lg; master: 1100). Reference: origin/master build (6e28d0e85). Question: is anything broken at any width on the change side. 1. Numbers renderdiff: 2 of 3 routes differ (14 of 28 shots), 0 errors. Clean (pixel-identical): / @375, 640, 767, 768, 1100, 1150, 1536, 1600; /product/data-apps at all 5 widths; /blog/authors/sameer-al-sakran @1600. Differ, all inside a moved band: / @600, 639 (sm), 1000, 1023 (lg), 1024, 1060, 1099 (hero window), 1279, 1280, 1366 (xl and container), 1440, 1535 (rails); author page @600 (FinalCTA sm) and @1530 (FinalCTA fade). /product/data-apps @375 first differed by a 1px span.rc-phone-underline width; base vs base shows the same 46↔47px, and its rerun was clean and is merged in. 2. What I saw - Horizontal page scroll (documentElement.scrollWidth > innerWidth): none, on either side, at any width of the three routes. - JS and layout in sync after settle: DataApps --data-apps-scale equals its fit() value at every width; EmbeddedAnalytics --ea-scale equals min(1, width/1160) from md and 1 below. - Navbar: 375/600/639 full width, 540 at 640-767, 720 at 768-1023, 960 at 1024-1279, 1280 at 1280, 1320 from 1366; nothing overflows. - Hero @1024-1099: the window sits at the dashboard's top + 262px, 64px past its right edge and inside the viewport (right edge 1008 @1024, 1083 @1099). It covers only the bottom-right of the "Payments received per quarter" chart (its bars, y-axis labels and Jan 2024-2026 ticks), the same elements it covers on master from 1100. The KPI ("Total Accounts 1,228") and the top "Accounts added per year" chart are clear. Master stacks it under the dashboard there, so the page is 416px shorter on the change side. - Hero @1100-1279: same boxes as master (that's why 1100 and 1150 are pixel-identical; 1279 differs only below the hero, in the container). - Other switches, all expected: @600-639 full-width container, stacked hero CTAs, one Love column; @1000-1023 tablet layouts (cropped CRM, stacked EA window, one-column cards and features); @1279 960px container (master 1140 from 1200); @1280-1366 1280/1320px container (master 1140); @1440-1535 no guide rails (master from 1400); FinalCTA stacked buttons below 640 and edge fade from 1536. 3. Not verified Hover and open-menu states; mobile nav not opened (navbar markup unchanged). Demo iframes masked (embed hosts blocked). The cookie banner shows on every shot (geojs is blocked) and sits over the hero window's title bar at 1024-1099, as over master's at 1100+. Reference is the master build, not production. 4. Call Expected change, no regression: every difference is a layout switching at its new Tailwind width, nothing scrolls sideways, overlaps the KPI or top charts, or desyncs at any tested width.

Pinned on both sides: clock starts at 2026-11-04T10:38:00.000Z on every load, a seeded Math.random, timezone UTC, locale en-US, light colour scheme, reduced motion, CSS animations and transitions off, animated images and SVG animations held on their first frame, videos kept from playing with video.js overlays hidden, every lottie-player held on frame 60.

Unstable pixels — ones that changed between two shots of the same load — are painted magenta on both sides, counted on each card, and excluded from the measurement. A route more than 25% unstable is an error.

Magenta is also padding where one page is taller or wider than the other. It counts against the score on purpose — see the height delta on the row.
